parts.label: Engine-to-PDK Adapter / Bellhousing Interface
parts.function: Adapter plate and bellhousing interface that mates the flat-six engine block to the PDK transaxle.

parts.label: Engine Mounts x2 — Hydraulic Rubber Mounts
parts.function: Pair of hydraulic rubber engine mounts isolating the mid-mounted flat-six from the chassis.

parts.label: PDK / Transmission Mount
parts.function: Hydraulic rubber mount supporting the PDK transaxle against the rear subframe.

parts.label: Differential / Final Drive Housing
parts.function: Final-drive differential housing with halfshaft flanges (WM 39 / Fig protective sleeve & flanged shaft).

parts.label: Rear Drive Shaft / Half-Shaft (Left)
parts.function: Left rear drive shaft from PDK flange to wheel hub with CV joints and bellows (WM 422119).

parts.label: Rear Drive Shaft / Half-Shaft (Right)
parts.function: Right rear drive shaft from PDK flange to wheel hub with CV joints and bellows (WM 422119).

parts.label: Inner CV Joints (Transmission Side) x2
parts.function: Constant-velocity joints at the transmission/halfshaft flange (WM Fig CV joint on transmission side).

parts.label: Outer CV Joints (Wheel Side) x2
parts.function: Constant-velocity joints at the wheel carrier / hub end of each rear drive shaft.

parts.label: CV Joint Bellows / Boots x4
parts.function: Corrugated protective bellows over inner and outer CV joints (WM 422855).

parts.label: Lug Bolts M14x1.5 Ball-Seat x20
parts.function: Set of M14x1.5 ball-seat lug bolts securing wheels to the hub flanges.
